_comment: User-study picks after visual inspection of every iteration preview (not only the critic). run = output dir on scratch; B = iter_<iter>_av.mp4 (16 steps, same noise as baseline_av.mp4) or optimized_final_av.mp4 when iter = 'final'.

goldfish.note: clean leap out of the tank; baseline never jumps
goldfish.edit: The goldfish jumps out of the fish tank into the air.

cat_yawns.note: wide early yawn (frames ~30-50); baseline yawns only in the last frame. alt: iter 9

man_shouts.note: hands come up from mid-clip and an open-mouth shout; baseline raises hands only in the last frames

boy_splashes.edit: The boy splashes the water with both hands.
boy_splashes.note: two-handed splash with water spraying up mid-clip (frames ~40-65); baseline only stands up out of the water. alt: iters 7, 8, 10

man_claps.note: RESERVE - clear sustained clapping (frames ~20-110) but H3 zooms out to a wider shot to show the hands (baseline is a tight face shot where hands meet once for ~3 frames). alt: iter 3. Framing change = weaker preservation.

car_door_opens.note: the driver door of the car on the lift swings open mid-clip (from frame ~45) and stays open, scene otherwise unchanged; baseline door never opens. alt: iters 3, 5. iters 6+ add extra people/objects (drift).

gen_woman_desk.note: user pick: iter 2 (wide yawn). Note: the run's own baseline also scored 0.91 on the critic.

gen_sealion.edit: The sea lion barks with its head raised.
gen_sealion.note: user pick: iter 2 best, iter 3 candidate; iter 4 added as candidate (critic best, 0.94); baseline opens the mouth only at the very end.

gen_koi_pond.edit: The koi jumps out of the water.
gen_koi_pond.note: user pick: best (final = iter 6 latents) with iters 4 and 6 as candidates; critic stayed flat at 0.003 - a critic miss, the jump is visible to a human.

gen_dolphin_sea.edit: The dolphin leaps out of the water.
gen_dolphin_sea.note: user pick: iter 2 - full dolphin leap with splash (frames ~30-70); baseline shows only the fin. iter 9 = weaker leap (candidate). iters 3-4 drift to the wrong animal (a bird / a dog leaping) - not candidates.

gen_woman_door.edit: The woman opens the door and walks inside.
gen_woman_door.note: user: iter 4 is ok-ish (door opens wider near the end than the baseline); later iterations add extra people (drift). Downscaled 320x512x89 source.

gen_cow_field.note: user: iters 3, 4, 7 are ok/good; iter 3 primary. Note: the run's own baseline also scores 0.88 on the critic.

gen_frog_jumps.edit: The frog jumps off the lily pad into the water.
gen_frog_jumps.note: user pick: iter 3 (full-size 448x768x124 source, 3-GPU run) - the frog jumps; critic stayed flat (another critic miss). baseline: frog leaves the frame only in the last frames.

gen_glass_table.edit: The glass tips over and spills the water.
gen_glass_table.note: user pick: iter 4 is good (downscaled 320x512x89 source); critic stayed flat (0.004 at iter 4) - critic miss; later iterations drift.

gen_glass_edge.edit: The glass falls off the table and shatters on the floor.
gen_glass_edge.note: iter 3: the glass tips off the edge (frame ~70) and visibly shatters into fragments on the floor; baseline makes the glass vanish with a few drops. iter 8 candidate: shatters earlier (frame ~25) but with duplicated-glass artifacts; iters 5/7 drift (a person's legs appear).

gen_windmill.note: user: iters 3 and 14 are ok (iter 3 primary). lin objective, trimmed source.

gen_wolf_hill.edit: The wolf howls with its head tilted up.
gen_wolf_hill.note: user: iter 3 is good. Note: the trimmed-source baseline also howls in a closer shot (critic 0.99); judge the videos.

gen_firecracker.edit: The firecracker explodes with a bang and a puff of smoke.
gen_firecracker.note: user (09-09 11:50): iters 7 and 8 are good. iter 8 primary (fireball + dense smoke cloud at frame ~25, critic 0.30), iter 7 alternate (flash + puff at the same moment, critic 0.43). Baseline = the source's small puff, no bang. Critic best was iter 9 (0.70).

gen_cat_vase.edit: The cat pushes the vase over and it shatters on the floor.
gen_cat_vase.note: user (09-09 06:30): iter 5 is good - the cat paws at the vase from frame ~2 and pushes until it tips over (critic miss 0.01). Baseline already knocks the vase over mid-clip (lunge at frame 6) - both do the motion; ours is an earlier, more deliberate push.

real_keaton.note: user (09-10 05:45): good. Real B&W footage (Buster Keaton, public domain), demo set. iter 5 primary (broad laugh from frame ~5, critic 0.9999, perceptual 0.07), iter 6 alternate; iters 9+ drift (second person, colour, other face). Baseline stays deadpan.

gen_plate_counter2.edit: The plate slides off the edge of the counter and drops onto the floor without breaking.
gen_plate_counter2.note: user (09-10 10:40): ok-ish, not bad. Ours tips the plate off at frames 2-3 and it lies intact on the floor from frame 4; baseline slides it off only in the last frames (10-12). Critic missed it (0.05); perceptual 0.32 (over the guard - fall edits move many pixels).

real_casablanca_hat.edit: She grabs her hat, throws it up into the air and laughs.
real_casablanca_hat.note: user (09-11 03:25): iter 4 is actually good -> packaged. Ours: the hat stays on until ~2.5 s, then she laughs with her head back and hands up while the hat leaves the frame, in a brighter, wider framing (perceptual 0.41, so the loop's own guard had rejected it; iter 5 alternate). Baseline: H3 grabs and throws the hat at ~1-2 s with only a slight smile after (critic miss 0.004).

real_michael_kiss.edit: He kisses the mug lovingly with a loud smooch.
real_michael_kiss.note: user (09-11 05:05): iter 15 is good -> packaged (iter 14 adjacent alternate). Critic best was iter 5 (0.11) and the critic scored iter 15 only 0.03 (critic miss). Baseline: H3 brings the mug to his lips and sips from ~0.5 s, no kiss.

real_tony_shout.edit: He suddenly shouts angrily at the camera, his face contorted with rage.
real_tony_shout.note: user (09-11 06:20): iter 10 confirmed. iter 10 = critic best (0.87) and the biggest yell; iters 9 and 8 alternates. Baseline: stares off, mouth opens slightly at ~2 s. Ours: full open-mouthed yell at ~1.9-2.8 s, head turning to the camera, perceptual 0.04, identity and dark room intact.

real_michael_cry.edit: He suddenly bursts into tears, sobbing loudly, his face crumpling.
real_michael_cry.note: PROVISIONAL (auto-pick 09-11 05:20, awaiting the user's verdict): iter 6 = the biggest open-mouthed sob with the head dropping; iter 7 alternate; critic best iter 4 alongside. Baseline: talking, a frown/cry only in the last ~20 frames. Ours: the cry starts ~0.6 s earlier and is a full sob; demo-grade for sure, study pair if the baseline's late frown does not count as crying.

real_leo_kneeslap.edit: He slaps his knee and bursts out laughing.
real_leo_kneeslap.note: user (09-11 05:40): iter 7 is really good -> packaged; iter 6 adjacent alternate; the loop's own best (total loss) is iter 1 = untouched, copied as B_criticbest. Two-part edit on the Leo couch source (user's idea after the spit-take failed). Baseline: sits with the can up, raises an arm near the end with a small smile (critic 0.95 on 'slaps his knee or laughs'). Ours iter 7: hand down to the knee within ~0.5 s, then a broad open-mouthed laugh rocking his body through the first half (critic 0.99, perc 0.08).

real_mrbean.edit: He faints and falls backwards into the field.
real_mrbean.note: user (09-10 + 09-11 06:20): iter 4 works -> packaged. Baseline: stands hands-on-hips checking his watch, no faint. Iter 4: tips backwards at frame 7 and lies flat in the rapeseed for the rest (critic 0.09, perceptual 0.32 = guard-rejected, eye pick). Critic best iter 9 alongside (falls then drops out of view).

real_casablanca.edit: She bursts out laughing, throwing her head back.
real_casablanca.note: user (09-11 06:20): iter 3 is good -> packaged (iters 2 and 4 alternates). Baseline already laughs late with the head back (critic 0.95); iter 3 laughs earlier (from ~1.5 s) with a slightly changed framing (perceptual 0.30, guard-rejected). Critic best iter 1 = untouched, alongside.

gen_woman_scream.note: PROVISIONAL (auto-pick 09-11 06:20 so every candidate can be reviewed in one place; awaiting the user's verdict): iter 2 = wide-open scream mid-clip vs the baseline's last-frame-only scream; iter 3 drifts. Note: on 09-10 04:20 the user said none of that overnight batch was good enough - re-judge.

gen_horse_neigh.edit: The horse throws its head up and neighs loudly.
gen_horse_neigh.note: PROVISIONAL (auto-pick 09-11 06:20 so every candidate can be reviewed in one place; awaiting the user's verdict): iters 3-5 throw the head up at frames 2-4 (early, stronger; iter 5 with the mouth open) vs the baseline's mild late head turn at frames 8-9. Critic missed it (0.03-0.07). A timing win rather than a baseline failure.

real_nosferatu.edit: The vampire bares his fangs and hisses, lunging toward the camera.
real_nosferatu.note: PROVISIONAL (auto-pick 09-11 06:20 so every candidate can be reviewed in one place; awaiting the user's verdict): subtle: the lunge is in the source; ours iter 2 opens the mouth and shows the fangs at frames 6-7 as the face passes the camera, the baseline keeps the mouth shut. Visible only on a head crop.

real_tom_walk.edit: The cat trips and falls flat on his face with a crash.
real_tom_walk.note: PROVISIONAL (auto-pick 09-11 06:20 so every candidate can be reviewed in one place; awaiting the user's verdict): modest timing win: iter 3 trips Tom at frame ~8 and leaves him sprawled (the pillow turns into a basket - the issue the user flagged); baseline trips him at frames 10-12. Critic best iter 6 alongside (baseline timing).

gen_plate_counter.edit: The plate slides off the counter and shatters on the floor.
gen_plate_counter.note: PROVISIONAL (auto-pick 09-11 06:20 so every candidate can be reviewed in one place; awaiting the user's verdict): partial: iters 2-3 slide the plate off ~1 s in but it lands intact (shatter lost); baseline slides it off late and shatters it. The follow-up gen_plate_counter2 ('drops without breaking') is the packaged one.

gen_books_shelf.edit: The books fall off the shelf onto the ground.
gen_books_shelf.note: PROVISIONAL (auto-pick 09-11 06:20 so every candidate can be reviewed in one place; awaiting the user's verdict): modest: iter 2 collapse starts earlier and fuller than the baseline's last-2-frames topple; iter 7 zoom drift. Note: on 09-10 04:20 the user said none of that overnight batch was good enough - re-judge.
